title: I WORE GOTH CROCS FROM WISH FOR A WEEK!! Very Questionable Fashion  😬😅
description:
GOTH CROCS / PUNK CROCS / PUNCROCS / I WORE GOTH CROCS FOR A WEEK / I WORE CROCS FOR A WEEK / WISH HAUL / WISH SHOES / WISH DIY 

Watch how to make your own Goth Crocs from Wish! 
https://youtu.be/S9WRM3V1aIw

The ORIGINAL Goth Croc!
https://www.etsy.com/au/listing/693360401/goth-crocs-original

I owe a huge thanks to the one and only Safiya Nygaard for bringing Crocs back into the spotlight last year with her video “I Wore Platform Crocs for a Week”. Check it out! (I’ve been trying to buy some of these for myself but they’re sold out 😭) 
https://youtu.be/L87HuKmGwVQ

I'm SO excited for this video! I was going to post a video called "I Wore Goth Clothes from Dollskill for a Week" but I didn't have any gothic shoes. Luckily for me, my best friend Sam had seen the Goth Croc trend blowing up over on Twitter and decided to make them for himself. He ordered supplies from Wish and turned a humble pair of gardening shoes into "puncrocs", and i'm in love with this questionable fashion decision! 

What do you think of these? Would you wear something like this out in public? Would you ever try to make shoes like this for yourself?
